text:
olivia: Hey team — need to onboard project redwood-inference-pilot-2026. Requesting GPU quota increases in us-west1 and europe-west4: +16 A100 (a2) and +24 L4. Need this for initial Dedicated validation.

samir: Do we have a billing account attached to that project yet? GCP will ask.

olivia: yes, billing-account: B-0a1b2c3d4e, I've added finance tag. Also adding the support case notes below.

kai: Just to confirm: A100s will be used for perf benchmarking and L4 for cheaper burst inference, right?

olivia: exactly — bench runs on A100, prod-like inference traffic on L4. We're targeting 12h/day sustained.

jeremy: finance ok with the billing account, but we need an ROI note for support case: expected spend delta ~$18k/month at current rates.

olivia: put short justification in the quota form: "Dedicated validation and pre-prod canary for new Dedicated customers; will enable early cost/perf tuning and SLA tests."

samir: filing support request now. Quick checklist: project ID, billing account, quota numbers, region list, justification, and contact email. Also attach the capacity plan doc.

quota-bot: [automated] New quota request created: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/projects?project=redwood-inference-pilot-2026 (case #CASE-2026-0815)

olivia: copying the gcloud command the support team asked for, in case anyone wants to run locally:

```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-inference-pilot-2026
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-inference-pilot-2026
```

samir: support asked for per-region breakdown. Can you paste the numbers?

olivia: us-west1: +10 A100, +12 L4; europe-west4: +6 A100, +12 L4.

kai: also note we might prefer us-central1 for better capacity for A100 — but latency to our test users favors us-west1. Should we request fallback in us-central1?

olivia: good call. Add request for a smaller quota in us-central1: +4 A100 (warm fallback). I'll update the form.

samir: done — updated case #CASE-2026-0815 with us-central1 fallback.

gcp-support: Hi Olivia/Samir — we've received the quota increase request. A few follow-ups: please attach a billing statement, and provide the list of VM families (e.g., a2-highgpu-1g, l4-standard-16) you'll use and whether these are preemptible.

olivia: we'll use a2-highgpu-1g and a2-megagpu-16g for A100 benchmarks (not preemptible), and l4-standard-16 for L4 (preemptible allowed for non-critical workloads). Attaching doc now.

jeremy: also confirm whether these are temporary for a 6-week validation or long-term. That affects approval speed.

olivia: initial approval asked for 6 weeks; we will submit a follow-up for long-term reserved capacity if the validation goes well.

samir: small ops note: quota increases may require project-level roles. I gave olivia compute.admin on the project so she can view quota panels.

olivia: thanks. I just uploaded the billing statement and the perf plan. Reply from GCP said they'll review by EOD tomorrow.

kai: if approval goes thru, we need to pre-warm images and chi-node setup. I'll start a checklist for node cfg and image bake.

olivia: checklist good — include NVidia driver versions and MIG configs for A100. We'll pin drivers to 535.x to match our runtime.

quota-bot: [automated] Case #CASE-2026-0815 updated by gcp-support. Status: Pending — more info requested.

gcp-support: Thanks for the attachments. One more item: please provide the expected sustained utilization percentage per GPU type (e.g., A100 60% util, L4 30%) and the estimated number of simultaneous VMs.

olivia: Estimated sustained: A100 55-70% (peak 12h/day), L4 25-40% with bursts. Simultaneous VMs: A100 8-12, L4 18-24.

samir: I'm going to add a short network note: requesting increase in NEGs and forwarding-rule quotas for us-west1 because we'll front with regional GCLB.

olivia: added NEGs +50 and forwarding rules +10 to the case.

gcp-support: Understood. We've escalated to capacity team for A100 in us-west1 and will update within 48 hours.

kai: thanks. If capacity team flags shortage, we should prioritize test runs in europe-west4 and fall back regionally.

olivia: noted. Will update the runbook with fallback policy: prefer us-west1, failover to europe-west4, then us-central1.

jeremy: approved on finance side for the 6-week validation spend. Please mark any additional spend over the estimate before it accrues.

olivia: will do — setting budget alert thresholds and adding myself and jeremy to billing alerts.

samir: awesome. I'll follow up here when the quota is granted or if GCP asks for more info.

olivia: thanks everyone :party-parrot:
